workshoptitle: Building and Operating My AI Staff on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Prepare OCI Infrastructure and Oracle AI Database (Manual Path)
tutorials.description: Manual deployment path: provision OCI, load the schema snapshot, and validate the vector model

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Click the Magic Button (Fast Path)
tutorials.description: Alternative deployment path: create a Resource Manager stack and bootstrap OCI, database, and runtime

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Install the My AI Staff Runtime (Manual Path)
tutorials.description: Manual deployment path: install dependencies, virtual environments, SELinux labels, and rclone

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Configure Slack Agents, Environment Files, and Services
tutorials.description: Import seven Slack apps, configure current identities, and enable systemd

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Connect Services and Verify the Deployment
tutorials.description: Run local, Slack, database, and end-to-end workflow verification

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Configure External Services
tutorials.description: Configure Gmail, Calendar, voice, email, and publishing integrations

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving live help
